actual_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: single cinematic 16:9 music-video storyboard still, concourse-010.
Input references: Image 1: authoritative survival-coverall wardrobe, Harper identity and concourse interior design; Image 2: personal spherical ship metal geometry and proportions; shell treatment comes from field reference; Image 3: thin cyan geodesic field and established illustrated finish; her old short-sleeve clothing is superseded here.
Create a new scene using these references: THE GLIMMER. Over Harper's shoulder in the quiet outer walkway, looking through a partially occluded opening toward a remote berth. Show only a tantalizing fragment of the established spherical personal ship: a vertical cyan engine-ring arc and an amber-edged graphite equatorial/platform segment beyond a structural pier. Do not reveal the entire sphere yet. Harper pauses in foreground left, her short auburn curls and gray survival coverall recognizable, head turned toward the light. Station architecture masks most of the ship; warm/cool contrast invites discovery. No cargo obscures her route.

CONCOURSE SEQUENCE LOCK: Cinematic painted graphic-novel space adventure with fine controlled ink contours, rich illustrated material detail, indigo space, cyan practical lights and warm amber edges. Adult Harper has the established freckled face, hazel-green eyes and short curly auburn hair; keep her adult proportions and identity. She has changed offscreen during pod transit into a practical pod-issue survival coverall: soft warm-gray fabric, roomy long sleeves with gathered cuffs, closed simple collar, plain central fastening, adjustable gray waist belt, slightly loose trousers, low graphite slip-on utility shoes, one tiny unlettered amber rescue tab at the upper arm. No helmet, armor, gloves, swimsuit, costume logos or readable lettering. Station is a worn but welcoming interstellar transport interchange built around a broad segmented graphite ring with ivory inset ribs, tall arching windows, amber floor-edge strips, cyan docking lights and branching radial berths. Interior promenade has dark ribbed arches, warm ivory wall panels and a few distant travelers; its quieter outer service walkway retains the same architecture. The small arrival capsule is the established enclosed ivory-and-graphite ovoid one-seat escape pod, without a large external ring. The discovered personal spacecraft is the established transparent spherical technological field with faint cyan geodesic lines, graphite equatorial band, upper/lower circular platforms, amber rim lights, sparse cyan rectangular lamps and one vertical open aft engine ring with cyan inner arc; never confuse these two craft. Keep only subjects needed for the shot. Each image is one uninterrupted full-frame 16:9 cinematic composition with a quiet bottom strip for later lyrics; no captions, readable words, watermarks, panels or collage.

validation.notes: Single Harper in coverall pauses in foreground; structural pier conceals most spacecraft. Only cyan ring arc, amber platform segment and narrow field fragment visible; no full sphere reveal.
